fixed.summary: Bound false HTML boolean attributes are absent from attribute selectors in both document builders; true values are present with an empty string. Data and ARIA false values remain selector-visible. Retained :default follows the checked attribute's presence.
Linear and radial gradient colour stops accept reduced calc() sums of percentages and pixels, including mask-image fades with a fixed pixel tail.
